UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE SOIL CONSERVATION SERVICE
P.O. Box 678, 200 W. Church St., Champaign, Illinois 61820
May 17, 1972
Mr. Sigmund C. Ziejewski Regional Transportation Engineer Department of Transportation Illinois Division of Highways 300 North State Street, Room 907 Chicago, Illinois 60610
Dear Mr. Ziejewski:
The draft environmental impact statement/section 4(f) for the proposed highway improvement on F.A. Routes 23 (U.S. Route 30) Lincoln Highway - Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road, Section: 22-23-12-4, Cook County, Illinois that was addressed to Dr. T. C. Byerly, Office of the Secretary, Department of Agriculture, Washington, D. C. on April 14, 1972, has been referred to the Soil Conservation Service for review and comment.
The importance of erosion control, adequate drainage, and reestablishment of vegetation have been recognized in the statement.
The Department of Agriculture in cooperation with the Metropolitan Sanitary District of Greater Chicago is making studies for preparation of "The Chicago Metropolitan Area River Basin Plan." This plan includes the area involved in . the proposed highway improvement. To obtain further information concerning the study you may wish to contact Mr. Edgar H. Nelson, River Basin Planning Staff Leader, Soil Conservation Service, The Morton Arboretum, Thornhill Building, Route 53 and Park Blvd., P.O. Box 475, Lisle, Illinois 60532, telephone 312-964-4660
If you have questions concerning the soils, erosion and sediment control, vegetative seedings, woodland or wildlife plantings, fertilization, borrow area development or any other soil and water conservation practice, don't hesitate to get in touch with Mr. Allan D. May, District Conservationist, 100 Manhattan Road, Joliet, Illinois 60433, telephone 815-723-5078.
We appreciate the opportunity to review and comment on this proposed project.
Sincerely,
Howard W. Busch
State Conservationist
